title: Night Sounds: Crickets and Frogs by a Summer Pond | Sleep 8 Hours
description:
8 hours of a warm summer night beside a still pond: a soft chorus of crickets, far-off frogs and quiet night air. No music, no rain, no talking.
The night never loops, with a gentle fade in and a slow fade out at the end. Made for falling asleep, staying asleep and summer nights.

0:00:00 Night begins
0:00:10 Crickets and frogs by the pond (8 hours)

Valley & Tide - nature sounds from wild places, for deep sleep.
New sessions every Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday.

Scenes and sounds are original, created with AI tools and edited by Valley & Tide.
